reconstructed_captions.1: The hand places a piece of wood onto the burning embers inside the oven.
reconstructed_captions.2: The hand carefully arranges the pieces of wood to help the fire grow.
reconstructed_captions.3: Flames begin to lick up around the newly added wood.
reconstructed_captions.4: The hand prods the embers and wood with a small stick.
reconstructed_captions.5: The fire inside the clay oven burns brighter after being tended.
reconstructed_captions.6: The hand is withdrawn from the opening of the clay oven.
